items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Timmie Rosenkrantz, who was running the show, came up to Don and myself and said to us

ctx.x: How was the -- how did it come about that the two of you ended up doing the duets on "Indiana" and "I Got Rhythm."

That's right. Now, during the show -- or during intermission Timmie Rosenkrantz, who was running the show, came up to Don and myself and said to us, "Hey, Slam and Don, why don't the two of you, when we go back on stage, just the two of you, why don't you do something

between the two of you?" I don't know whether he was trying to put us on or what have you, but he mentioned "Why don't the two of you go out there and do a couple of numbers for us, to start the show off, you know."
